description: Synthetic caller speech, by case-build/render_caller_audio.py: 7 calls from Google's gemini-3.8-flash-tts (prebuilt voice Kore) with director's notes asking for US Spanish, requested as 24 kHz PCM and resampled to 16 kHz with ffmpeg; the other 7 from Rime's HTTP API (Coda, speaker brisa, lang spa) at 16 kHz, after Gemini's rate limit stopped the render. The voices are AI-generated, not recordings of a person. Deepgram, the speech-to-text vendor, transcribes neither voice. Rime is also the agent's text-to-speech vendor, as the Coda speaker nieve. OpenAI was not used.
in_git: Only the files listed under samples are committed; the rest are regenerated, and their SHA-256s here identify the recorded run's bytes.

director_notes.Kore:
# AUDIO PROFILE: Marisol, a bank customer calling from the United States
## DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Language: Spanish as spoken in the United States (es-US).
Accent: US Latina, Mexican-American.
Style: natural and conversational, a little tired, like a real phone call.
## TRANSCRIPT

accent.requested: US Spanish (es-US): for Gemini's Kore, director's notes ask for Spanish as spoken in the United States with a Mexican-American accent; Rime lists brisa (Coda) as Spanish, country US
accent.status: instructed, not verified by a listener
accent.language_check: A local faster-whisper large-v3-turbo detected Spanish for every file before the runs (probability in the manifest); that says the language, not the accent.

price.price_source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (gemini-3.8-flash-tts, paid tier: $0.50 / 1M text input tokens, $9.00 / 1M audio output tokens through 2026-12-31); cost per file from the usageMetadata Gemini returns, director's notes included

gemini_rate_limit: gemini-3.8-flash-tts rendered 23 lines, then returned HTTP 429 three times on 2026-09-30 (metric generate_requests_per_model, limit 10, 'retry in 46 to 55 s'), the last after a 75 s pause and requests 7.5 s apart. That is a short-window rate limit, not the 100-a-day cap. Rendering stopped there: the 7 calls voiced by Kore keep Gemini audio, and the other 7 calls, planned for the Gemini voice Leda, were rendered by Rime's Coda speaker brisa. One Leda file was rendered and not used. A first Rime render with the Mist v3 speaker dolores was discarded after a local Whisper check: Whisper heard its '6603' as '6006-103', '4471' as '$4,430', 'seis pagos de 102 dólares' as '16 Agos D 112A' and 'seis pagos' as 'usáis packs'; Coda's brisa read the same number lines cleanly. The discarded files' costs are in the ledger.
